title: The Inheritance of Little Hawley
author: Quentin Ishikawa
blurb: Bram Crane, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the trial begins.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
